editorial.lede: Spain's spy agency warned of mass crossings into Ceuta before the border crisis, according to Al Jazeera. Spain failed to secure EU sanctions against Morocco over the Ceuta border entry, Morocco World News reported. Within the PSOE, the political handling of the Ceuta crisis has produced disarray, El Pais reported: "Si intentábamos salir de esta, nos hemos embarrado más".
